text:
anya: Quick one — publisher creds for EU staging arrived but marketing wants localized blurbs before we push. Who can validate copy + legal?

isaac: I can wire up the creds to the staging publisher account. Send the locales and I'll run a render check.

emily-marketing: I'm on EN/FR/DE. Need the short and long descriptions and hero strings. Any character limits?

sarah-legal: Legal needs to sign off on the short description and privacy snippet. Can you drop the proposed text here? I can give quick edits.

anya: Proposed short: "Redwood Inference — hosted & private LLM inference with predictable latency and flexible deployment." Long: "Ship LLM features with a single API across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Includes KMS integration, compliance controls, and cost-optimizing runtimes."

emily-marketing: Short is tight, but fits. For DE/FR I'll translate and keep 120 chars max for the hero. Will post drafts in this thread.

isaac: I deployed the staging listing to pub-staging-eu. Link: https://publisher.staging.example.com/listing/rdw-eu. Rendering looks OK but hero truncates at 96 chars in the storefront preview.

emily-marketing: Noted — I trimmed the hero to: "Predictable LLM inference across hosted, dedicated, private environments." Posting FR/DE text in 10m.

sarah-legal: Quick legal tweak: remove any implication of data residency guarantees for hosted plan unless customer signs private deployment addendum. Suggest: "Data residency available via private deployments subject to contractual terms."

anya: Good call. Emily, can you update EU copy to include that sentence in the legal snippet area?

emily-marketing: Done. Also added localized privacy line. Pushing assets: icons (128x128) and hero (1024x512) to the assets folder.

devops-bot: staging-cred-check: pub-staging-eu credentials successfully validated at 2024-06-15T14:22:00Z.

isaac: I noticed the GCP publisher form still requires the service account email in a different field than AWS. Left a comment in the onboarding doc.

anya: Action items: isaac validate creds + publish preview, emily finalize localized copy and assets, sarah quick legal signoff on the snippet. Reconvene post-preview.

isaac: Preview looks good after the copy tweak. No blockers from my side.

sarah-legal: Signed off on the snippet. Shared updated doc: https://go.example.com/eu-listing-legal-redlines

emily-marketing: All locales uploaded. Thx everyone.

anya: Great — plan to kick private offer testing tomorrow. Closing thread for now.
